meta.cadence: 1-week sprints, Mon–Sun, planning Monday, demo/retro Sunday evening (Dubai time)
meta.estimate_note: Hours are wall-clock for you driving Claude Code, including review and testing. S≈1–1.5h, M≈2–3h, L≈3.5–4h. Anything > 4h was split.
definition_of_done: PROGRESS.md updated; any new decision appended to DECISIONS.md; guard.sh green
Deployed to production (dark behind its flag if incomplete); prod smoke passed
Migration applied on local + staging; pgTAP/RLS tests for touched tables green
Domain service has Vitest coverage for rules; zod schema at every boundary
UI matches Varun's prototype screen/flow; no new UI patterns (D-027)
UI works in all 6 themes at 360px and 1280px; loading/empty/error states present
Domain events emitted; PostHog event mirrored where the feature is a KPI
Feature behind a flag if it touches money, messaging, AI or ranking
Playwright smoke updated when a critical flow changes; CI green on the PR
Docs: CLAUDE.md / ADR / feature spec updated if behaviour or structure changed
Sreejith reviewed the diff (no self-merge by Claude Code)
meta.release_rule: Every sprint ends with a production deploy (Sunday, after demo). Unfinished features ship dark behind their flag; nothing half-built is reachable by users. Migrations follow the two-release rule so the previous app version keeps working. The demo runs on production, not staging.

decisions_locked: Region ap-south-1 (irreversible-ish — confirm before creating prod project)
D-023 session protocol, D-027 UX fidelity
D-028 deploy to production every sprint

sprints.goal: Real collectors are in. Cohort 1 shadowed closely, cohort 2 once stable. Explicit buffer absorbs carry-over so earlier sprints never silently overflow.
sprints.demo: Production live; first offers and first token purchase observed; KPI dashboard populated.
sprints.risks: Support load; OTP delivery in the wild; cost surprises — daily check for week 1.

tasks.title: Seed production
tasks.desc: countries, token packs, brands/castings, flag defaults (invite_only on), admin users, Stripe live keys.

tasks.title: Cohort 1 onboarding (10–15 users incl. 2 shops)
tasks.desc: Shadow sessions, hotfix loop, daily KPI/cost check.

tasks.title: Cohort 2 onboarding
tasks.desc: Remaining invites; monitor; weekly report #1.

tasks.title: Buffer for carry-over
tasks.desc: Reserved. Anything not done in S0–S10 lands here; if unused, pull from stretch register.
